t: This is St Margaret Lothbury, a parish church on Lothbury, spanning the boundary between Coleman Street Ward and Broad Street Ward. It's recorded since the twelfth century, was destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666, and was rebuilt by the office of Sir Christopher Wren. It's still a working parish church, and the official church of five Livery Companies, two Ward Clubs and two Professional Institutes. Local finance houses hold special services here each year. Buried here are John Cleland, author of Fanny Hill, and John Boydell, the publisher and engraver who became Lord Mayor. Sir Hugh Clopton, another Lord Mayor, died here.
